## 1.1.1 Part one

::: {#def-widget .definition name="Widget"}
A *widget* is a thing with
$$ w = 1. $$
:::

::: {#thm-widget .theorem name="Widget theorem"}
Every widget is a widget.
:::

::: {.proof}
1. Trivial.

2. Done.
